text: Do not wait a week, extend this frozen sample, promote the descriptive gates, or threshold-rescue the mechanism.
Any new Deribit test requires a separately preregistered mechanism, event-count stopping rule, and claim boundary.
registered_permission.how_satisfied: This file is the separate preregistration. Only screen_definition (question, sources, block definition, sample minima, gates, truth table) is copied from the parent contract and equality-checked at runner load. The GEX formula, RV completeness and validity rules, rank/tie, ratio, per-asset, leave-one-out, and UNKNOWN semantics are NOT duplicated here: they remain single-sourced in the hash-pinned parent contract (semantic_amendment, final_semantic_amendment) and the hash-pinned parent module focused-deribit-gex/fast_intraday.py, which executes them. The stopping rule is an event count with no wall-clock cap; the claim boundary is stated above.

stopping_rule.type: event-count earliest stop; no wall clock
stopping_rule.rule: Chronologically order transitions by outcome-block end. The stop is the earliest outcome-block end at or before the derived window end at which every registered sample minimum first holds (parent find_earliest_stop, executed verbatim). Transitions ending after the stop are excluded from gates. If no such end exists inside the window, the verdict is inconclusive on the full window.
inputs_the_stop_may_read: count of GEX-computable trades in signal blocks that form transitions
count of transitions: a signal block with >=1 computable trade, nonzero dealer GEX, and an AVAILABLE next-block RV under the parent completeness rule
sign counts of dealer GEX blocks

the parent RV availability rule itself: >=720 in-block index observations, no consecutive gap >5000 ms, anchor within 5000 ms of block start, final observation within 5000 ms of block end, AND every price in the block finite and positive (a nonpositive, nonnumeric, or nonfinite captured price marks the block unavailable, no imputation)
inputs_the_stop_never_reads: any realized-volatility magnitude computed from valid prices
any correlation, ratio, or gate statistic
stopping_rule.note: RV availability is a data-integrity property. Its price-validity clause is inherited verbatim from the parent semantic amendment and is disclosed here because it inspects captured price values (validity, not magnitude): a block excluded for an invalid price is recorded in the results rv_journal with its reason. No block can be excluded because of how large or small its RV is.

claim_boundary: This trial can falsify or fast-screen-pass the registered mechanism on its own frozen truth table. It cannot establish durable alpha, replace prospective confirmation, certify survival under the frontier-loop policy, overturn any prior verdict, pool with any prior window, authorize deployment, or support capital allocation.

governance.campaign_minting: scripts/campaign.py init --gate deribit-gex-eventstop --prereg deribit-gex-eventstop-contract.json, run from quant-trading/explorations; init hashes this file before any compute and the runner refuses a manifest whose prereg_sha256 differs.
governance.independent_review: Read-only pre-freeze review (agent EventStopPrefreezeReview, 2026-09-02) of the first draft returned NOT CLEARED with six findings; each was corrected or disclosed in this draft before minting: (1) snapshot lifecycle -> in-memory prepare, exclusive publication, no resume; (2) canonical next_gate conflict -> owner authorization bound above with governing-file hashes; (3) price-validity clause of RV availability -> disclosed in stopping_rule; (4) commit barrier -> pins re-verified before module load and before publication, create-only fsynced writes, owner copy hash-checked; (5) tests -> fail-closed lifecycle, RV-permutation stop invariance, multi-day dedupe, metadata boundary; (6) verbatim-scope wording -> narrowed. The review JSON is copied into the run directory. The reviewer was denied access to raw capture files.

frontier_loop_relation.relation: Not a frontier-loop cycle. This is a preregistered re-test inside the focused campaign lineage (accelerated-intraday-contract.json, 2026-08-30), whose gates are deterministic threshold rules with no inferential p-value; the loop policy's alpha_k applies only to p-value gates. No loop ordinal is claimed or consumed, no alpha is spent, and no outcome here can be certified, replicated, or promoted under that policy. If the owner later rules that an ordinal was consumed, the trial remains non-inferential and nothing changes in its result.
frontier_loop_relation.closed_family_check: The Deribit screen is inconclusive, not closed-negative; its registered next_experiment explicitly permits a separately preregistered event-count-stopped test. No closed family is tuned, pooled, extended, re-windowed, or revived.

terminal_verdict_mapping.fast-screen-pass: CLOSED (a fast-screen pass is not FROZEN-CERTIFIED: no replication window exists and the parent claim boundary forbids survival or alpha claims)

governance.post_outcome_updates: Only status fields: strategy-registry.json focused_campaign.*, focused-campaign.json, focused-deribit-gex/strategy.json (status, trial_count, gate_result, next_experiment). No threshold, formula, or contract edits.

owner_authorization.channel: direct user directive in the working session (owner: jinleic)
owner_authorization.text: Run ONE Deribit taker-GEX trial with an event-count stop, end to end, NONSTOP: freeze first, before reading any data past 2026-08-31T03:15:00Z: new contract restating parent mechanism/formulas/RV rules/gates/thresholds verbatim; window start 03:15:00Z; stop = earliest outcome-block seal where all five parent minima hold, derived from trade counts + block boundaries only, never from RV or gates. Hard cap = stat-first byte prefixes + sha256 recorded now. No wall clock. Run exactly once. Truth table unchanged. No pooling, no threshold changes, no rerun.
owner_authorization.conflict_disclosed: strategy-registry.json focused_campaign.ranked_results[1].next_gate reads 'Any further work requires a separately frozen different mechanism, stopping rule, multiplicity boundary, and input-continuity plan.' Independent pre-freeze review read 'different' as scoping the mechanism; the owner directive retests the SAME mechanism with a different stopping rule. This trial proceeds on the owner's authority, satisfying the remaining clauses as: separately frozen (this contract, minted by campaign.py init), different stopping rule (event count, no wall clock), multiplicity boundary (single trial; an inconclusive result closes the lineage), input-continuity plan (frozen byte prefixes, fail-closed per-stream coverage, no live tail). The registry entry is updated post-outcome to record this authorization and the result.

governance.governing_authority_verification: Both files are hash-verified at runner load, again immediately before the parent module is loaded, and again immediately before publication. They are edited only after publication, and only in status fields, as disclosed in governance.post_outcome_updates.
